site.home.seo_description: Free jobs, courses, business support and mentors for young South Africans - online and at your nearest Kasi Digital Hub.
site.home.headline: Your future starts in your kasi
site.home.lead: Find work, learn new skills and start your own business - free for young people, with real help at a hub near you.
site.home.cta_hint: All you need is a cellphone number.
site.home.what.work.title: Find a job that fits you
site.home.what.work.body: We turn your experience - even piece jobs - into a CV and show you jobs that match, with a score out of 10.
site.home.what.learn.title: Learn skills employers want
site.home.what.learn.body: Short courses on your phone, with certificates that count when you apply.
site.home.what.start.title: Start and grow a business
site.home.what.start.body: Register your business step by step and get ready for funding.
site.home.what.connect.title: Get a mentor
site.home.what.connect.body: Talk to people who have done it before and want to help you grow.
site.home.how.1.title: Sign up with your phone
site.home.how.1.body: No email or password - just your cellphone number and a PIN.
site.home.how.2.title: Tell us about yourself
site.home.how.2.body: Your experience, skills and what you want to do. Your hub can help.
site.home.how.3.title: Get matched
site.home.how.3.body: Jobs, courses, mentors and business support that fit you.
site.home.partners_body: Hire local talent, fund real outcomes and reach young people where they live.
site.home.final_body: It's free and takes about two minutes.

site.funders.points.4: Partner offers for banking, insurance and funding - only when young people choose them
site.about.title: About Kasi Digital Hub
site.about.seo_description: Kasi Digital Hub is a national platform and network of community hubs helping young South Africans find work, learn and start businesses.
site.about.headline: One platform. A hub in every kasi.
site.about.body.1: Kasi Digital Hub brings jobs, skills, enterprise support and mentorship together in one place - online and through physical hubs in townships and villages across South Africa.
site.about.body.2: Every hub is run locally and connected nationally, so a young person in Tsutsumani or Soweto gets the same opportunities as anyone else.
site.about.body.3: The initiative is led by Ku Tirhisana Consultancy, with HBM EduTech as learning partner. Young people never pay to use KasiHub.
site.about.values.2: Your information is yours - we only share it when you agree
site.about.values.3: Real help from real people at your hub
site.help.title: Help and questions
site.help.seo_description: Answers to common questions about signing up, PINs, documents, privacy and using Kasi Digital Hub.
site.help.lead: Can't find your answer? Contact us or visit your nearest hub.
site.help.a.free: No. KasiHub is free for young people. You only pay for your own airtime or data.
site.help.a.sign_in: Enter your cellphone number. On a new phone we send you a code by SMS, then you enter your 5-digit PIN.
site.help.q.forgot_pin: I forgot my PIN. What now?
site.help.a.forgot_pin: On the PIN screen, choose 'I forgot my PIN'. We send a code to your phone and you choose a new PIN.
site.help.q.no_smartphone: I don't have a smartphone. Can I still use it?
site.help.a.no_smartphone: Yes. Visit your nearest hub - a facilitator will help you sign up and use the computers there.
site.help.q.documents: Why should I upload my documents?
site.help.a.documents: Once a document is verified, every service can use it. You upload it once and apply faster.
site.help.a.privacy: Only you, and the people you allow - for example an employer when you apply. You can change your choices any time under Privacy in your account.
site.help.q.whatsapp: Can I get messages on WhatsApp?
site.help.a.whatsapp: Yes. Switch on 'WhatsApp updates' in your account. We never send messages late at night, except security alerts.
site.help.a.hub: A Kasi Digital Hub is a place in your community with computers, internet and people who help you with jobs, courses and business.
site.help.q.age: How old do I need to be?
site.help.a.age: 18 or older for all services. If you are 16 or 17, you can use courses with a parent or guardian's permission.
site.help.q.delete: How do I delete my account?
site.help.a.delete: Go to your account and choose 'Delete account'. We delete your information within 30 days, except what the law requires us to keep.

start.guide.title: How should your business be set up?
start.guide.not_advice: This is general guidance, not legal advice. For complicated situations, ask your hub to connect you with an adviser.
start.guide.sole.liability: You are personally responsible for the business's debts.
start.guide.sole.registration: No CIPC registration; business income goes on your own tax return.
start.guide.sole.when: You are starting small and alone, e.g. a stall, hair or a trade.
start.guide.pty.who: One or more shareholders; run by directors.
start.guide.pty.liability: The company is a separate legal person; owners are usually not personally responsible for its debts.
start.guide.pty.paperwork: Annual returns to CIPC and company tax returns.
start.guide.pty.when: You want to grow, have partners, or need to supply bigger companies and government.
start.guide.coop.who: At least five members who run it together, one member one vote.
start.guide.coop.liability: Separate legal person; members are usually not personally responsible for its debts.
start.guide.coop.paperwork: Meetings, member records and annual returns.
start.guide.coop.when: A group shares the work and the benefits, e.g. farmers or sewing groups.
start.guide.npc.who: No owners; run by directors for a public benefit.
start.guide.npc.paperwork: Annual returns; profits can't be paid out to members.
start.guide.npc.when: The aim is community benefit rather than profit.
